error.tooManyRules.message: Scoring can have at most {max} rules. Switch off or delete one first.

error.duplicateRule: Two rules have the same id. Reload Scoring and make the change again.
error.points: Points go from −50 to +50, and can't be 0.
error.list: That list doesn't exist in this workspace any more. Pick another list, or any list.
error.contains: Keep the text to look for in the link under 200 characters.
error.formGone: That form was deleted. Pick another form.
error.event: Name the API event with letters, numbers and . _ : -, like trial_started.

error.fieldGone.message: The field {field} was deleted. Pick another field.
error.fieldGone.note: field: a custom field's key, like plan

error.values.message: Enter at least one value for {field}.

error.op: Pick how the field is checked: is one of, is not, or is set.
error.kind: Pick what the rule counts: an event or a field condition.
error.cap: Pick a cap for the rule.

error.capBelowPoints.message: A cap of {cap} {period, select, day {a day} week {a week} other {a month}} is lower than the {points} points {kind, select, open {one open} click {one click} form {one form submission} api_event {one API event} soft_bounce {one soft bounce} other {one unsubscribe}} gives. Raise the cap to {points} or more, or lower the points.
error.capBelowPoints.note: cap and points are numbers; period: day, week or month

error.decayWeeks: Decay starts after 1 to 52 weeks without a human open or click.
error.decayPercent: Decay takes 1% to 100% of the score each week.
error.warmFrom: Warm starts at a score from 1 to 99.

error.hotFrom.message: Hot starts above Warm ({warm}) and at 100 at most.

error.conflict: Someone saved scoring after you opened it. Reload to see their changes, then make yours again.
error.nothingToRetry: No recalculation stopped, so there is nothing to try again.
error.notSetUp: This workspace hasn't set up scoring yet.

notify.recalcTitle.note: the notification when a recalculation of every contact's score is done

notify.recalcBody.message: {changed, plural, one {1 contact changed band} other {# contacts changed band}}{flows, select, one { · {flow1} {start, select, yes {started} other {not started}} for {n1}} two { · {flow1} {start, select, yes {started} other {not started}} for {n1} · {flow2} {start, select, yes {started} other {not started}} for {n2}} three { · {flow1} {start, select, yes {started} other {not started}} for {n1} · {flow2} {start, select, yes {started} other {not started}} for {n2} · {flow3} {start, select, yes {started} other {not started}} for {n3}} other {}}
notify.recalcBody.note: flow1…flow3: the names of "Score crosses…" automations; n1…n3: how many contacts each started (or would have started) for
